Identifying distinct server surfaces that enforce memo visibility. Starting to enumerate the first enforcement site.

Enumerating distinct enforcement sites across API routes, fileserver, RSS, frontend SSR, SSE hub, email notifications, user notifications, attachment service, reactions, and memo attachments.

Refining the search to distinct server surfaces rather than individual helper calls. Additional surfaces under review include memo relations, user stats, and ACL/authz. Will verify exact enforcement paths in key functions such as canModifyMemo, mention helpers, and memo share logic.

Eleven distinct enforcement sites identified. These include API read access checks, list filters, fileserver attachment permissions, RSS and frontend visibility restrictions, SSE hub filtering, email and notification viewer checks, attachment service access controls, reaction and attachment listing services, memo relation filters, and user stats visibility.

Confirmed list filters restrict which memos a viewer can see. Now checking authz/ACL, public memo endpoints, memo share, and common.go for additional enforcement sites.

Checking memo share, mention helpers, ListMemos, and ACL to identify every distinct enforcement site.

Found 13 distinct enforcement sites so far:

- API memo read — `checkMemoReadAccess` in `memo_service.go`
- API memo list — `ListMemos` visibility filters in `memo_service.go`
- HTTP fileserver attachment access — `fileserver.go`
- RSS feeds — `rss.go`
- Frontend sitemap — `frontend.go`
- SSE event delivery — `sse_hub.go`
- Email notifications — `notification/email.go`
- User notification API payloads — `user_service_notifications.go`
- Attachment API — `attachment_service.go`
- Reactions API — `reaction_service.go`
- List memo attachments — `memo_attachment_service.go`
- Memo relations visibility filter — `memo_relation_service.go` / converter
- User stats — `user_service_stats.go`

Mention inbox dispatch — `canUserAccessMentionContext` in `memo_mention_helpers.go`

Reorganizing by distinct enforcement surfaces instead of individual calls. New sites found:

- `checkAttachmentPermission` — `fileserver.go`
- `checkAttachmentAccess` — `attachment_service.go`
- `ListMemoReactions` visibility — `reaction_service.go`

Reconsidering whether to list individual functions or broader server surfaces. The 14 sites identified so far may be too granular; the user likely wants HTTP entry points like gRPC, file server, RSS, and frontend instead.

Will list the main distinct enforcement sites comprehensively while avoiding duplicate helpers that enforce the same rule. Also checking `GetMemoShare` in memo share.

I am compiling the distinct memo visibility enforcement sites and their file paths.

Twelve enforcement sites are now identified across the codebase. These include `checkMemoReadAccess` and `ListMemos` in `memo_service.go`, `checkAttachmentAccess` in `attachment_service.go`, `checkAttachmentPermission` in `fileserver.go`, reaction and attachment visibility checks in `reaction_service.go` and `memo_attachment_service.go`, relation filtering in `memo_relation_service.go`, batch conversion filtering in `memo_service_converter.go`, SSE client checks in `sse_hub.go`, RSS public-only listing in `rss.go`, and frontend sitemap public-only access in `frontend.go`.

The count reaches fifteen. Additional enforcement sites include `canViewerAccessMemo` in `notification/email.go` and `user_service_notifications.go`, user stats visibility in `user_service_stats.go`, and `canUserAccessMentionContext` in `memo_mention_helpers.go`. The list is now comprehensive.

`CreateMemoComment` also enforces parent memo visibility before allowing comments. The final list will be limited to distinct enforcement surfaces rather than exhaustive duplicates.
